description: National Expenditures on Bicycles and Accessories and U.S. Imports of Non-motorized Bicycles is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Data from the U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Economic Analysis, National Income Product Accounts on real personal consumption expenditures on bicycles and accessories and data from the U.S. Department of Commerce, Census Bureau, USA Trade Online on U.S. imports of non-motorized bicycles and other cycles, including delivery tricycles. Data by month. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 11 columns, among them measure, source, metricnum, value, date, id. The portal shows 2026-06-10 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
